FwupBlock.description: One 8-byte block of firmware transfer data as two 32-bit words, as the frame handler mcu_0160_0800672c stores it. Used for the previous and the current block of the transfer (protocol_fwup_prev_block at 0x200006D4 and protocol_fwup_cur_block at 0x200006DC).

fields.name: word0
fields.description: First four bytes of the block, in the frame's byte order. Holds the raw (still encrypted) data when the block is stored.

fields.name: word1
fields.description: Last four bytes of the block, in the frame's byte order. Holds the raw (still encrypted) data when the block is stored.

TelemFrameTail.description: Bytes 1 to 7 of the 8-byte telemetry payload at 0x20000310. Filled by mcu_telemetry_group_get for each request ID, then queued with mcu_msg_ring2_enqueue_frames. Byte 0 is not part of this struct.

fields.name: byte1
fields.description: Payload byte 1. Its source depends on the request ID: the sensor word in 0x211, the status byte in 0x341, and the group flag in 0x343, and so on.

fields.name: halfword2
fields.description: Payload bytes 2 and 3. Filled as one 16-bit write in most request IDs; the low byte comes from the first source of that ID and the high byte from the second.

fields.name: bytes45
fields.description: Payload bytes 4 and 5. No direct write line in the packet; they are written through a 32-bit packing expression in mcu_telemetry_group_get, so their exact source is per request ID.

fields.name: byte6
fields.description: Payload byte 6. In frames 0x210 and 0x212 it is copied from protocol_telem_count_1ff6; in 0x342 it is the high byte of a 16-bit value.

fields.name: byte7
fields.description: Payload byte 7. In frames 0x210 and 0x212 it is copied from protocol_telem_temp_a; in 0x401 it is zero.
